title: MergePilot Demo Platform Data Contract v1
description: Unified data model served by the Demo Backend. Every field carries a provenance source. All responses pass through the redaction layer (see redaction.rules). Two providers implement this contract: replay (read-only over locked evidence dirs) and live (read-only real APIs; returns LIVE_DATA_UNAVAILABLE per-source when down).

replay.writes: NONE — runtime write forbidden, evidence dirs never modified; approval POST only mutates an in-memory demo overlay marked 'REPLAY ACTION — NO RUNTIME WRITE'

reads: AgentLoop/OTel (not implemented — always reported as such)
live.writes: approval POST only against protected Demo Backend approval endpoint; credentials stay server-side (env), never returned

pull_request.write_actions: bool — always false for this runtime (PR writes never authorized)

agents.matrix_id: string (homeserver part as recorded; partially elided in evidence)

timeline_event.event_id: string — short platform id (real Matrix event ids kept in matrix_event_id)
timeline_event.timestamp_precision: exact|approx|windowed — honest when evidence gives a range
timeline_event.matrix_event_id: string|null — real event id from evidence
timeline_event.trace_id: string|null — always null: AgentLoop/OTel not implemented (honest)

approval_api.GET /api/cases/:id/approval: returns historical record (from evidence) + current demo overlay (replay-only)

trace_api.reason: AgentLoop/OTel not implemented in this phase; only an evidence-replay trace schema exists (PHASE14-WINDOWS-AGENTLOOP-OTEL-20260829-200307/trace-schema.json). Never displayed as live.

residual_risks: MinIO shared tree 曾发生异常清空，已恢复，根因待查
tool_guard 曾导致会话超时，当前策略已调整
VERIFICATION_PASSED 状态枚举兼容问题
AgentLoop/OTel：未接入（仅定义了 evidence-replay trace schema，无 live capture）

rules: scalar values under secret-like keys (password|secret|token|api key|cookie|authorization|bearer|credential) are replaced with [REDACTED], except display-safe key names (sha256/digest/hash/checksum) and allow-listed demo placeholders
Bearer tokens, gh*/sk*/AKIA* style tokens, JWTs and `key=value` secret assignments are masked inside free strings
allow-list (PR #2 repo demo placeholders, explicitly permitted): TOP-SECRET-OUTSIDE-BASE, WELCOME-LEGIT-DEMO, outside-secret.txt, deep-secret.txt, welcome.txt, LEAKED_OUTSIDE_SECRET
no password/token/api-key/cookie is ever stored or returned; server-side credentials live only in process env
redaction.self_test: backend/test/selftest.mjs asserts masking on crafted samples and no-leak on all API responses

field_provenance: Every API payload embeds a `sources` map (field → evidence dir/file or live endpoint). The frontend renders source refs as evidence links; SHA256SUMS of each evidence dir are recomputed at backend start and exposed via /api/health and /api/cases/:id/audit.
